title: BioIVT: psoriasis treatment frequencies use the shared frequency list
description: Turns the free-text Frequency questions for oral steroid, topical and other treatment on the Psoriasis form into pick lists using the shared canon_cm_freq list (CDISC CMDOSFRQ plus documented extensions, including Other).
rationale: Free text becomes a pick list per rule 1 to 6 of the approved choice-list rules; the list was built and verified earlier.
source: BIOIVT_BEFORE_AFTER.html Phase 1 plan, approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 1 build. Approved by Dan after reviewing the before/after page.
